thread:
ashley: Pushing config for mosaic-3b (quantized) to s3://redwood-models/mosaic-3b/ — quick lint before I open the PR?

thomas: Thanks — can you confirm weights path + checksum? Last time CI failed because the tar had a nested folder.

ashley: weights: s3://redwood-models/mosaic-3b/weights/part-0000.tar.gz
ashley: sha256: 3b7f1e2a5d9c4e8f6a0b2c9d5e4f1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1k2l3m4n5o6p7q8

jia: quick note: tokenizer.json currently lists special_tokens as strings, not objects — our serving needs ids for pad/unk/eos. Will the tokenizer build script add them?

ashley: right now tokenizer.json: { "special_tokens": ["[PAD]","[UNK]","[CLS]"], "vocab_size": 50288 }
ashley: I ran the tokenizer builder locally and it outputs a mapping, but the model config references `tokenizer_path` not `tokenizer_mapping` so lint complains.

schema-lint-bot: config.json failed validation (schema v2):
schema-lint-bot:  - error: unknown field \"vocab_type\" (line 12)
schema-lint-bot:  - error: missing required field \"tokenizer.special_token_ids\"

schema-lint-bot: run `tools/config-lint --schema v2 --file config.json` for full output

thomas: Unknown field likely came from a conversion script — remove or rename to `tokenizer.vocab_format`. For the missing special_token_ids we expect an object: `{"pad": 0, "unk": 1, "eos": 2}`.

ashley: ok will update. Do we have an allowed default for max_seq_len? Currently set to 2048 but serving prefers 1024 for latency SLOs.

jia: set `max_seq_len` in config to 1024 and add `runtime_defaults: {"prefill_max_length": 1024}` so the runtime can enforce batching behavior. Add a comment in the PR explaining tradeoff.

ashley: pinging @thomas for review after I push the fix. Also adding a small smoke test: `python -m tests.run_inference --model s3://redwood-models/mosaic-3b/ --prompt "hello"`

ops-bot: deploy-check: model size 6.1GB, estimated GPU memory (int8) 8GB, passes size threshold.

thomas: one more thing — update config schema version to 2.1 in the top-level field so lint runs the newer validator that allows `runtime_defaults`.

ashley: pushed changes + updated tokenizer to include special_token_ids. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/pulls/4823 :nerd_face:

jia: on CI now. If lint still fails, paste the output here and I'll help triage.

schema-lint-bot: CI lint stage passed for config.json

ashley: thanks all — marking this thread resolved once CI canonicalizes the tokenizer files into s3://redwood-models/mosaic-3b/tokenizer/ and weights checksum verified.

thomas: LGTM, will do a quick serve smoke tomorrow during low traffic window. :thumbsup:
